question: Retrieve distinct case references, case numbers, investigation numbers, and clone information where a single clone simultaneously exhibits all three of the following genetic alterations: (1) a loss on chromosome 13 between positions 48,303,751 and 48,481,890, (2) a loss on chromosome 17 between positions 7,668,421 and 7,687,490, and (3) a gain on chromosome 11 between positions 108,223,067 and 108,369,102. For each matching clone, display the chromosomal details for each of these three regions (including chromosome number represented by ChrOrd, start position, and end position) and the corresponding karyotype short description from the KaryClone table. Use the CytoConverted and KaryClone.
sql:
WITH chr13_loss AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `end` as EndPos,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr13' AND Type = 'Loss'
    AND Start < 48481890 AND `end` > 48303751
),
chr17_loss AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `end` as EndPos,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr17' AND Type = 'Loss'
    AND Start < 7687490 AND `end` > 7668421
),
chr11_gain AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `end` as EndPos,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr11' AND Type = 'Gain'
    AND Start < 108369102 AND `end` > 108223067
),
matching_clones AS (
  SELECT c13.RefNo, c13.CaseNo, c13.InvNo, c13.Clone
  FROM chr13_loss c13
  WHERE c13.rn = 1
  INTERSECT DISTINCT
  SELECT c17.RefNo, c17.CaseNo, c17.InvNo, c17.Clone
  FROM chr17_loss c17
  WHERE c17.rn = 1
  INTERSECT DISTINCT
  SELECT c11.RefNo, c11.CaseNo, c11.InvNo, c11.Clone
  FROM chr11_gain c11
  WHERE c11.rn = 1
)
SELECT 
  mc.RefNo,
  mc.CaseNo,
  mc.InvNo,
  mc.Clone,
  c13.ChrOrd as Chr13_ChromOrd,
  c13.Start as Chr13_Start,
  c13.EndPos as Chr13_End,
  c17.ChrOrd as Chr17_ChromOrd,
  c17.Start as Chr17_Start,
  c17.EndPos as Chr17_End,
  c11.ChrOrd as Chr11_ChromOrd,
  c11.Start as Chr11_Start,
  c11.EndPos as Chr11_End,
  kc.CloneShort as KaryClone_Short
FROM matching_clones mc
LEFT JOIN chr13_loss c13 
  ON mc.RefNo = c13.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c13.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c13.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c13.Clone AND c13.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN chr17_loss c17 
  ON mc.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c17.Clone AND c17.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN chr11_gain c11 
  ON mc.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c11.Clone AND c11.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone` kc 
  ON mc.RefNo = kc.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = kc.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = kc.InvNo AND mc.Clone = kc.CloneNo
ORDER BY mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone
